prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1249; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: [Claimant name].

Q: Thank you. Do you understand this call is being recorded?
A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you tell me where the accident happened?
A: It was on a multi-lane road in Sugar Land, Texas, near a shopping center entrance. I was in the right lane and wanted to move over to the left lane to make a turn.

Q: What happened when you changed lanes?
A: I checked my mirror and didn't see anything, so I signaled and started moving over. Then I heard a loud bang and felt my car jolt. The other vehicle had been in my blind spot and sideswiped my driver's side.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: No. I only saw it after the contact, when it was pulling slightly ahead of me.

Q: Did either vehicle leave the roadway?
A: No, we both stayed in our lanes after it happened. I pulled onto the shoulder once I could safely stop.

Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. My right knee hit the steering column and the door frame. It's swollen and painful, and I have trouble bending it and putting weight on it.

Q: Have you seen a doctor?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same day and I have a follow-up scheduled with my regular physician.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add?
A: I just want to make sure my medical bills and the repairs to my car are handled properly.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
